text: Such a shy man as I be!” “Yes—she’s very vain. ’Tis said that every night at going to bed she looks in the glass to put on her nightcap properly.” “And not a married woman. Oh, the world!” “And ’a can play the peanner, so ’tis said. Can play so clever that ’a can make a psalm tune sound as well as the merriest loose song a man can wish for.” “D’ye tell o’t! A happy mercy for us, and I feel quite unspeakable!
